correctness.rationale: PASS for independent X,Y uniformly sampled by two-dimensional area on all six faces of a positive rectangular box. The joint two-face sampling assigns total weight p_i=abc/(a_i(ab+bc+ca)) to the opposing pair perpendicular to axis i. Conditional even moments yield Q=(a^2+b^2+c^2)(ab+bc+ca)+2abc(a+b+c), W as explicit homogeneous expression, E[D^2]=2Q/(3H), E[D^4]=2(5Q^2+W)/(45H^2), K=(5Q^2+W)/(10Q^2). Direct exact integer polynomial expansion of (19Q^2−W)/4 confirms 15 positive monomials, hence strict K<12/5. Sorting a>=b>=c and substituting a=w+v+u,b=w+v,c=w makes (75W−649Q^2)/4 consist of 39 nonnegative monomials with a positive w^6(u^2+uv+v^2) term for noncube, hence unique min K=512/375 at cube. Leading Q=2t^3,W=76t^6 for (t,1,1) proves sharp unattained 12/5; IVT gives every intermediate value. Independently regenerated both full positive polynomials without relying on a numerical Monte Carlo estimate.
